title: Become a Founder
subtitle: Back the game's development and lock in Founder status. The free game stays fully competitive. Pro is a badge and an identity, never an advantage.
prorataNote: Your first charge covers only the rest of this month, so it may be smaller than the listed price. Full price applies from the 1st.
checkoutPaused: Purchases are temporarily paused while we finish the terms of sale and self-service cancellation. Existing accounts and the free game are unaffected.

alreadyFounder: You're a Founder. Thank you for backing Cycling Zone from the start.
founderSeatsFull: All Founder seats are taken. New subscribers still get full Pro.
founderExplainer: The first 50 paying subscribers become Founders. Founders keep a permanent Founder badge, even if the subscription later lapses.
fairnessNote: Never pay-to-win: money buys depth, comfort and cosmetics, never a competitive edge.
termsAccept: I accept the <termsLink>Terms of Sale</termsLink> and expressly consent to CZ Pro being delivered immediately, acknowledging that my right of withdrawal thereby lapses for the started period.
